positives: Root is resolved correctly; one nonblocking fcntl build-lane lock.
Pre-existing build outputs cause refusal; module/build-logic output paths explicit; symlink cleanup refused.
JDK21, strict verification, one worker, no parallel, no daemon; no global caches removed.
Stops Gradle before capture/cleanup; source before/after identity includes modified + untracked files.

required_changes.proof: collect_reports/artifact inspection exceptions are only recorded, then every task output is deleted; neither capture error affects PASS expression. Copy failure therefore loses required results and may still pass.
required_changes.recommendation: Make preservation failures fail the receipt, retain exact remaining required artifacts with explicit cleanup debt, and always record failed capture + recovery path.

required_changes.proof: Second SIGTERM/KeyboardInterrupt raised during finally is BaseException and bypasses Exception guards; scratch removal, source identity and process scan also sit outside protective finalizers. A cleanup error can prevent remaining safety steps/final receipt.
required_changes.recommendation: Defer repeated cancellation during finalization; guard each stage independently; use nested guaranteed finalizers for stop/output cleanup/final receipt.

required_changes.proof: invoke terminates the direct command process only on interruption. The final pgrep records but never classifies/stops task-owned surviving workers/descendants, so app/test/subprocess survival is not excluded by PASS.
required_changes.recommendation: Run task command in a distinct process group/record its descendants; verify only task-owned survivors, terminate them when no longer needed, never terminate unrelated processes; record inability to establish ownership as failure.

additional_notes: Metadata parsing errors should be visible as evidence failures, not a green verification gate.
source_changed_during_cycle must prevent attributing success to one frozen source identity; coordinate freezes around root lane.
Before arbitrary --command usage re-review effective toolchain/signing arguments and ownership (Gradle common flags are intentionally not appended).
Sensitive-file exclusions omit .jks/.pem/.key; do not inventory any private material of these kinds if present.
